title: Veyrnox store listing per-locale metadata
description: One file per shipping locale under store-metadata/<locale>.json — the source of truth for what gets uploaded to App Store Connect (appInfoLocalizations + appStoreVersionLocalizations) and Google Play Publishing API (listings.update). The upload script scripts/upload-store-listings.mjs reads every .json file that does NOT start with an underscore.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag matching one entry in src/i18n/SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.

reviewed.description: True iff a native reviewer has looked at this store copy AND vouches for its meaning. If false, upload script warns and can be blocked with --require-reviewed.

apple.description: App Store Connect fields. subtitle + promotionalText + keywords + description + whatsNew are per-appStoreVersionLocalization; supportUrl + marketingUrl + privacyPolicyUrl are per-appInfoLocalization.

play.description: Google Play Publishing fields. shortDescription + fullDescription are per-locale on the main store listing.

releaseNotes.description: Play track release notes (What's new). Apple caps whatsNew at 4000 and Play caps this at 500, so it is a SEPARATE, shorter string -- never apple.whatsNew reused. Play also attaches release notes to a track RELEASE rather than to the listing, so this field is NOT uploaded by upload-store-listings.mjs; see scripts/play-release-notes.mjs.
